examples.label: Run the wpDiscuz unauth upload exploit to drop a shell
Execute commands through the uploaded webshell

notes: The upload bypasses the MIME check by appending a valid image header; the shell lands under wp-content/uploads/<year>/<month>/. Grab the exact filename the exploit prints - it's randomized.

recommended.note: Another vulnerable-plugin path on the same target.
Upgrade the webshell to an interactive reverse shell.

name: WordPress - wpDiscuz Unauthenticated RCE
description: Exploits the wpDiscuz 7.0.4 arbitrary file upload (CVE-2020-24186) to drop a webshell without authentication, then execute commands via the uploaded file.

defense.why_it_works: The wpDiscuz comment plugin (< 7.0.5) validates uploaded file MIME types client-side only, trusting the Content-Type header. An attacker can upload a PHP webshell with .php extension — the server stores and executes it.
defense.prerequisites: wpDiscuz plugin installed and activated. Comments enabled on at least one post. No server-side file-type enforcement.
defense.impact: Unauthenticated RCE as the web server user (www-data). Full webshell access enabling data exfiltration, lateral movement, and persistence.
defense.detection: POST request to wpdiscuz-ajax.php with a PHP file. New .php file in /wp-content/uploads/. Access log shows GET to newly created PHP file shortly after upload.
defense.artifacts: Web server access logs (POST to wpdiscuz-ajax.php, GET to .php) | File system: .php files in /wp-content/uploads/ | WordPress audit log (new comment from attacker IP)
defense.splunk_spl:
index=sysmon EventCode=1 (ParentImage="*w3wp.exe" OR ParentImage="*httpd*" OR ParentImage="*apache*" OR ParentImage="*php-cgi*" OR ParentImage="*php-fpm*" OR ParentImage="*java.exe" OR ParentImage="*tomcat*")
| where match(Image, "(?i)(cmd|powershell|bash|sh|nc|python)")
| table _time, Computer, ParentImage, Image, CommandLine

index=web sourcetype=access_combined (method=POST OR status=500)
| stats count by clientip, uri_path | where count>3
defense.elastic_kql: event.code:"1" AND process.parent.name:(w3wp.exe OR httpd OR apache2 OR php-fpm OR java.exe) AND process.name:(cmd.exe OR powershell.exe OR bash OR sh OR nc OR python*)
defense.sentinel_kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","httpd","apache2","php-fpm","php-cgi","java.exe","nginx")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","bash","sh","nc","python")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
| sort by Timestamp desc
// wpDiscuz arbitrary file upload RCE (CVE-2020-24186) - apache/php spawning a shell
defense.prevention: Update wpDiscuz to 7.0.5+. Validate file extension and MIME via php_fileinfo, not Content-Type. Deny PHP execution in uploads directory.
defense.misconfiguration: wpDiscuz < 7.0.5 trusts client-supplied Content-Type for validation. Web server has no upload directory execution restriction.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# wpDiscuz < 7.0.4 -- relies on JS/Content-Type check only (bypassable)
# /wp-content/plugins/wpdiscuz/utils/class.WpdiscuzUCF.php
# Only checks $_FILES['wmuAttachment']['type'] -- client-supplied MIME
# No server-side extension whitelist, no real content inspection

# Apache -- no php_flag engine off in uploads dir
# /wp-content/uploads/ -- PHP execution enabled (default)
<Directory /var/www/html/wp-content/uploads>
    # No php engine off directive = uploaded PHP files execute
</Directory>
defense.secure_config:
# WordPress -- disable PHP execution in uploads directory
# /wp-content/uploads/.htaccess
<Files *.php>
    deny from all
</Files>
# Also add to Apache vhost:
<Directory /var/www/html/wp-content/uploads>
    php_flag engine off
    Options -ExecCGI
    AddHandler cgi-script .php .pl .py .jsp .asp .sh .cgi
</Directory>

# wp-config.php -- harden file permissions
define('DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT', true);
define('DISALLOW_FILE_MODS', true);

# Update or remove wpDiscuz -- patch available in 7.0.5+
# wp plugin update wpdiscuz
defense.evasion: Alternate PHP extensions (.php5, .phtml) if extension blacklist is incomplete. Change Content-Type to image/gif.
